title: Onye Iro Na-ere Ọkụ
intro: N'oge mbụ nke mkpughe, otu onye pụtara dị ka onye na-emegide eziokwu siri ike. N'ịbụ onye a gọziri n'akụ na ụba na ọkwa, mkpụrụ obi a họọrọ mpako karịa nduzi, akụkọ ha ghọkwara ịdọ aka ná ntị siri ike n'amaokwu ikpeazụ nke surah.
clues: Ebi m n'otu obodo ahụ na onye amụma ahụ, anọkwa m n'ime ndị ikwu ya kacha nso, mana mpako m mere ka m ghara ịhụ eziokwu anya.
Enwere m nnukwu akụnụba na ọtụtụ ihe onwunwe, echere m na ihe onwunwe m ga-echebe m mgbe niile.
Mgbe e kpughere ozi ahụ, achịrị m ya ọchị n'ihu ọha wee tụgharịa uche, na-ewere onwe m dị ka onye ka ndị kwere ekwe mma.
A kpọrọ m asị nke ukwuu nke na otu sura nke Quran gwara m okwu kpọmkwem, na-akpọ m aha ndị ọzọ maara m.
A dọrọ m aka ná ntị na akụnụba m na ego m na-enweta agaghị abara m uru, a ga-atụbakwa m n'ọkụ na-ere ọkụ.
A maara m dị ka nna nke ire ọkụ, nwunye m ga-ebukwa nkụ ahụ n'olu ya na eriri nkwụ.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ọ jụrụ okpukpe Islam ma megide onye amụma ahụ n'ihu ọha
A haziri atụmatụ igbu onye amụma ahụ
Duru mgbasa ozi ọha na eze megide ndị Alakụba
trial.answer: Ọ jụrụ okpukpe Islam ma megide onye amụma ahụ n'ihu ọha

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Tufuru akụnụba ya mana ọ nwụrụ n'ọkwa nsọpụrụ

arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verse: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained. (111:2)
